# Standardized MIB IOI experiments

Open `../notebooks/mib_ioi_experiments.ipynb` from the repository root in the existing
**Python (mib-sketching CUDA)** kernel. The clean source is generated by
`../build_mib_ioi_notebook.py`; neither baseline notebook is modified.

The official checkout is at `../external/MIB-circuit-track` (ignored by Git).
Set `MIB_REPO` to use another local checkout. Its EAP submodule must be present.
The notebook imports official source directly and verifies the resolved module
locations. It does not install a similarly named PyPI package or replace IOI data.

To recreate the inspected checkout in a fresh clone, run from the project root:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/hannamw/MIB-circuit-track.git external/MIB-circuit-track
git -C external/MIB-circuit-track checkout b759df34433c9e31043ba9e02908ce0bf20e894f
git -C external/MIB-circuit-track -c url.https://github.com/.insteadOf=git@github.com: submodule update --init --recursive
```

The inspected EAP submodule commit is
`7af394a5662de8b23ad6154716a0cd3993d447a3`. MIB's README and scripts were inspected
along with its dataset, metrics, evaluation, model mapping, and EAP implementation.
Two observed API details are documented in the notebook: node attribution requires
`"EAP"`, and node graph JSON export fails on the logits sink at this revision.
The notebook uses the official `.pt` serializer and verifies its round-trip instead.

For headless execution in the existing environment:

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe run_mib_ioi_notebook.py
```

`--smoke` executes all sections with explicitly reduced 16-example prompt subsets.
It creates a separately labeled executed notebook. The default run uses 128 train
and 128 validation examples, 12 EAP-selected heads, and small batches. Public test
is opt-in. Initial model/data retrieval requires network access.

Each run exports to `results/mib_ioi_<UTC timestamp>_<id>/`. CSV summaries and NPZ
per-example arrays share component, pair, mask, and example indices as documented
in the notebook. Exact score caches depend on model, data, code, selected heads,
and batch size. `RESUME_DIR` can reuse matching caches; reported costs on a resumed
execution cover only work actually performed in that execution.

For singleton/pair work only, disable random-mask, fitting, sample-efficiency, and
official-evaluation flags. The small training-only EAP selection pass can also be
skipped by supplying a prior EAP-derived `selected_components.csv`. Public-test
data and test-mask targets must not be used to select methods or hyperparameters.

Validation commands:

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe review_checks\test_mib_ioi.py
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe review_checks\validate_mib_ioi_results.py results\mib_ioi_<run>
```

The second command validates a completed full experiment, independently recomputing
held-out metrics and training-only regression coefficients. Official local MIB
evaluation outputs are preserved exactly; they are not private leaderboard scores.
